title: Finite affine chart cover with closed affine-space presentations
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. A finite affine chart cover of $f$ consists of a finite affine open cover $(V_v)$ of $Y$, a finite affine open cover $(U_{v,i})$ of each $f^{-1}(V_v)$, natural numbers $d_{v,i}$, and closed immersions $e_{v,i}:U_{v,i}\to T_{v,i}=\mathbf A^{d_{v,i}}_{V_v}$ [def-sbc-affine-space] whose projection composites are the restricted morphisms of $f$. Empty charts are permitted. Record the open complements $W_{v,i}=T_{v,i}\setminus e_{v,i}(U_{v,i})$ and their quasi-compact inclusions. Define $D=\max d_{v,i}$ and, for natural chart constants $c_{v,i}$, $c=\max(c_{v,i}+1+2(D-d_{v,i}))$, each maximum zero for an empty family. For a finite commutative coefficient ring $A$, the chartwise open-complement predicate means that each inclusion $W_{v,i}\to T_{v,i}$ satisfies [def-exc-open-complement-bound] with constant $c_{v,i}$.
